description: Shopee is an ecommerce marketplace platform. Its Open Platform lets developers build integrations for sellers and merchants to manage products, orders, logistics, marketing, and related shop operations.
summary: Shopee exposes a seller-focused HTTP Open Platform API at `https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2` plus an OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://mcp.shopee.com/openai/v1`; no public GraphQL API or CLI was found.
